descriptions.d24i_grid_fans_header_8010bfb0: Forward two-pass grid fan scan: seeks the run-length cursor at +28 to the layer start, then for each cell seeks it and reads the cell flags from the grid; type 16 draws a triangle fan (0x8010b318) from corner heights after a 4-byte header, type 17 draws corner triangles whose neighbour low-nibble type (0x8010b57c) matches; a height of 0xffff is absent; the first pass draws the near half, the second the far half.
